core_obligations: Identify the clockwise composite (proof lines 8273-8297): the map f_*K tensor^L f_*M -> Rf_*Tot(K tensor M) obtained by going around clockwise is adjoint to the composite Lf^*(f_*K tensor^L f_*M) = Lf^*f_*K tensor^L Lf^*f_*M -> Lf^*Rf_*K tensor^L Lf^*Rf_*M -> K tensor^L M -> Tot(K tensor M).
Rewrite that composite using the adjoint push-pull compatibility lemma (proof lines 8298-8311), replacing the Lf^*Rf_* maps by f^*f_* maps, without changing the composite.

Identify the anticlockwise composite (proof lines 8312-8330) as adjoint to the composite through Lf^*Tot(f_*K tensor f_*M) -> Lf^*f_*Tot(K tensor M) -> Lf^*Rf_*Tot(K tensor M) -> Tot(K tensor M), and rewrite it using the same lemma (proof lines 8331-8369).

Conclude by the diagram chase (proof lines 8370-8419): every polygon of the displayed diagram commutes, the top one by the tensor-pull-compatibility lemma, the square of the two naive cup products because Lf^* -> f^* is functorial, the square involving the two maps A tensor^L B -> Tot(A tensor B) for the same reason, and the remaining square on the level of complexes, which is the definition of the naive cup product; the outer composites are the two maps identified above, so the original diagram commutes.
This also settles the compatibility of the two constructions on the level of the displayed diagram in the statement (statement lines 8243-8270).
proof_roadmap: Describe both composites as adjoints of explicit maps Lf^*(f_*K tensor^L f_*M) -> Tot(K tensor M).
Normalise both using the adjoint push-pull compatibility lemma so that only f^*-maps remain.
Conclude with the diagram whose polygons are commuting for the four named reasons; the outer composite of that diagram is exactly the pair of maps already shown to agree.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is a compatibility statement between the cup product built from the derived tensor product of pushforwards and the naive cup product built from total tensor complexes (statement lines 8243-8270). The proof (proof lines 8272-8419) is a two-sided computation: both composites are written as adjoints of explicit composites of pullback maps, the adjoint push-pull compatibility lemma is used to normalise them, and then a displayed diagram is checked polygon by polygon, each commuting for a named reason (tensor pullback compatibility, functoriality of Lf^* -> f^*, and the definition of the naive cup product). H2: a careful diagram computation, fully written out by the author with the reason for every polygon.
